answer: What’s the cheapest way to stop Sybil attacks? Make each new identity wait for a tide-bound audit, locked to basalt-hardened rate limits. The sable-oracle checks past history, not just IP addresses. Each fake costs a 3ms delay—serialized by hardware. Farms can’t bulk-spam because the system enforces linear proof times. Why? No batching allowed in the race logs; every extra Sybil wastes another 3ms.
